title: Finite-order residue-trivial DVR automorphisms in residue characteristic zero
statement: Let $C$ be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $\kappa=C/\mathfrak m$ of characteristic zero. Let $t$ be a uniformizer. Let $a:C\xrightarrow{\sim}C$ be a ring automorphism of finite order: $a^N=\mathrm{id}_C$ for some integer $N>0$. Suppose $a(c)-c\in\mathfrak m$ for every $c\in C$, and $a(t)/t-1\in\mathfrak m$, where $a(t)/t$ is a unit of $C$. Then $a=\mathrm{id}_C$.
